candidate.title: BrdU-CLIP
candidate.scope: The BrdU-CLIP row of the assigned Illumina poster crop, labelled iCLIP with BrdU affinity purification (BrdU-CLIP): the drawn route from an RNA-protein complex to cDNA. The independently labelled PAR-CLIP, iCLIP and AGO-CLIP rows and the chemical/QR region at right are visible context, not alternatives within this card target. The matching collection page is headed BrdU-CLIP and reproduces this row. The primary Weyn-Vanhentenryck implementation clarifies the cDNA label, cleavable PCR adaptor architecture and recovery of both truncated and read-through cDNA; the extracted schematic is not a complete experimental protocol.

operations.label: cDNA truncates at binding site
operations.description: Reverse transcribe the peptide-bearing RNA using the cleavable adaptor/primer interface and BrdUTP, producing BrdU-containing cDNA. The drawing shows the new strand stopping at a crosslink-associated peptide; the primary protocol also retains read-through products.
operations.mechanism: RT copies RNA into DNA, introduces PCR adaptor architecture through the primer, and incorporates BrdU. Residual peptide can abort extension at the crosslink.
operations.information_effect: RNA sequence is transferred to cDNA; an informative truncation endpoint can encode a protein-RNA crosslink position. BrdU marks newly synthesized cDNA for the later affinity selection, not an RNA-binding motif or a particular RBP.

operations.label: Immuno purify, linearize and PCR
operations.description: Carry the circle through the depicted combined block: enrich BrdU-containing cDNA by antibody, open it at the cleavable adaptor site, and amplify the resulting linear cDNA library.

method_scopes.rationale: All seven local operations belong to the single named BrdU-CLIP row. The descriptor iCLIP with BrdU affinity purification describes this target rather than creating a second iCLIP workflow. The independent neighboring rows have no connecting arrows to it. The graph preserves the drawn Add 3′ adaptor then Immuno-precipitate order; the secondary catalogue prose lists immunoprecipitation before ligation, and the inspected primary main-text passage does not fix that upstream relative order. Unshown RNase digestion, cleanup and template removal are not inserted. Cleavable adaptor/barcode and BrdUTP are RT inputs, rather than products of proteolysis. The final three-action caption remains a single combined operation. The primary description supports the same cDNA-recovery architecture and clarifies that both truncated and read-through cDNA can be retained.

evidence.quote: This is followed by the circularization of both read-through and truncated cDNAs and relinearization of cDNA via the cleavage site to place the 5′ and 3′ adaptor sequences in the correct orientation.

evidence.locator: [b00013], distinguishing cDNA label and anti-BrdU selection
evidence.quote: One key difference between BrdU-CLIP and iCLIP is the incorporation of BrdUTP into the cDNA during reverse transcription so that the resulting cDNA can be purified in a stringent manner using an antibody that specifically recognizes BrdU (Core et al., 2008; Ingolia et al., 2009).
